text: Hello boys and girls, welcome back to Sophie's class, hope you can enjoy it.In today's lesson, we are going to read an article about a special experience, and then we will learn how to write a vivid article by adding some action description.Please get your student's book and worksheet ready.Look, a notice is posted on the notice board.Since the section is called Memory Corner, I'm going to write about my special experience in my memory.And I believe you will write about your special experience, right?Please think about how to write about your special experience.What point of view and what tense will you use?I think I am going to write in the first person, because it is my own personal experience.I'm going to describe the experience mostly in the simple past tense, since it happened in the past.However, what kind of experience can be called special?Kitty, what's your idea?I think a special experience should be a different experience.If everyone has the same experience as you, you can't call it a special experience.Good.How about you, Peter?In my opinion, a special experience should be surprising.When you tell others about it, others will feel amazed.Last week, Tom put a spider on my hand.I believe it is a special experience.Good job.Thank you.Now, look at these two experiences.Which one is special?Kitty, what do you think?I think going diving in Thailand is a special experience, because most of us have never tried it.However, having delicious food isn't special at all.We all have some delicious food while traveling.Well done.A special experience can be exciting, interesting, amazing, or even frightening.All in all, a special experience shouldn't be ordinary.One of my students, Jane, has written an article for the section Memory Corner.First, look at the pictures Jane gave us.Can you guess who Jane is?Right.Jane must be the girl in yellow.How about the man beside her?Yes, maybe her dad.What about the other man in the last picture?Oh, yes, he may be a bank clerk.What happened to them?Now, please look at the pictures and think of one or two key phrases to describe each picture.For picture one, he gives one phrase, put a card into the ATM machine.For picture two, he gives two phrases, came out and put a 100 yuan note into his wallet.For picture three, he also gives the phrase, came out.And for picture four, he gives the phrases, picked up and put the notes into a basket.For the last picture, he gives the phrase, thanked Jane and her dad for their help.Very good.After reading these pictures, you may be eager to know how Jane described her special memory.Please open your student's book and turn to page 82.Complete Jane's article with the correct forms of the verbs in the box.Before you do it, I want to ask you a question.What verb tense should we use?Great.Since the story happened in the past, we should use the simple past tense.You can use some of the verbs more than once.Let's check.Peter, can you have a try?This is a special memory for me.Early one morning, I went to the international bank with my father.He wanted to take out 100 yuan.He put his card into the ATM machine.A 100 yuan note came out.He put it into his wallet.Then the machine began to make a funny noise.More notes came out.This went on for about 10 minutes.Then it stopped.And the answer to number 6 can be either came or pulled.Peter, please continue.Thank you, Peter.This time, please read Jane's article again and think about the structure.We can find there are two parts that aren't in the simple past tense.They are the beginning.And the ending.That is my special memory.Both of them present the topic, a special memory.And then the second paragraph talks about how the event started.The third and fourth paragraphs talk about what special experience Jane had.And the fifth paragraph tells what happened at last.It is clear that Jane described what special experience she had in detail.Then please read the second paragraph of Jane's article and find out what information she introduced.你发现了什么,Peter?好,现在我们知道,在大多数情况下,我们需要介绍基本的元素,例如,谁,什么时候,什么时候先。这样,读者可以更好理解文章。我们继续吧!读第三和第四篇文章,并查询Jane如何描述她的特殊经历。读四篇文章,并查询Jane如何描述她的特殊经历。然后,机器开始发出有趣的声音。这是她听到的。然后,她描述了她看见的。然后,她说,我们拿起笔记录,把它们放进一个大袋子里。我们立刻告诉他所有东西。她告诉读者,她做了什么。Jane对她的感受描述了什么?一些学生可能说,不。然而,看看这两个文章。他感到惊讶。我们立刻感受到Jane的惊喜。然后,机器的反应也显示,这件事很不一般。在实际上,Jane对她感受描述了什么?记得用读者的特殊经历为详细描述。然后,你也可以写下,她看见的,她听见的,她做的,或者她感受到什么。让描述更明显。现在,看看这两个文章。请准备两个词词,并告诉我们,哪个声音比较鲜艳?请准备两个词,并告诉我们,哪个声音比较鲜艳?现在,您可以写下您的特殊记忆。请取出您的工作室,并写下在Task 2中。我突然发现一只糟糕的狗躺在草上。我静静地走过它,并在腕上保护它,为了确保它受伤。不幸的是,一只狗的脚踢坏了,因此它无法再移动。别担心,我会带你回家。我哭泣,然后我赶快回家,向妈妈求帮。我们与狗狗合作了。从那开始,狗狗一直在我身边。我非常幸运地与狗狗合作了。谢谢,朱迪。让我们来看看朱迪的工作。她把基本的元素介绍了吗?例如,谁,什么时候,什么地方?她在详细中描述了她的特殊经历吗?她写了她看到的,她听到的,她做的,她感觉的。她用了正确的词来描述行动吗?她用了许多词,例如,吼和哭,来描述行动。她用了第一个人和简单的词吗?做得好,朱迪。您可以用这个检测标识来评估自己的写作。这就是今天的工作。祝您有个美好的一天!
